Diagnosis.submission: The nginx-thrift deployment (the OpenResty/nginx frontend gateway for the social network) is crash-looping with OOMKilled (3+ restarts). The root cause is an injected memory limit on the nginx-thrift container: the current ReplicaSet (revision 2) sets resources.limits.memory=256Mi and resources.requests.memory=128Mi, whereas the baseline revision (revision 1) had NO resource limits at all. 256Mi is far too small for the OpenResty gateway, so the container exceeds the limit and is OOMKilled on startup, causing the pod to enter CrashLoopBackOff/BackOff. Because nginx-thrift is the single entry-point gateway proxying all /api and /wrk2-api requests to the backend microservices, this outage breaks the entire social network. All other pods are Running with 0 restarts.
